stemMarkdown: If 18 men can build a wall in 21 days, how many days will 36 men take to build the same wall, working at the same rate? (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: The wall needs $18 \times 21 = 378$ man-days of effort regardless of who does it. With 36 men that is $\dfrac{378}{36} = 10.5$ days.
